report.explanation: All admitted evidence in the 14:35-14:40 window is healthy: checkout trace OK at 67ms, gateway log 200/ok, error_rate 0.001, p95 73ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters. The gateway deployment (3.1.5, 1605 min old, valid config) cannot by itself establish latency or failure. No taxonomy cause is substantiated and no bounded alternative is established, so hand off rather than assert a root cause.
missing_evidence: No error or latency signal in current window: traces show one OK checkout at 67ms, logs 200/ok, metrics error_rate 0.001 and p95 73ms.
No per-dependency telemetry (order, inventory, payment, postgresql, redis) to test db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, or downstream-latency.
No evidence of configuration invalidity or error-rate spike to support bad-configuration or http-500.
No memory-retention time series to assess memory-leak; single sample of 49152000 bytes is insufficient.
